title: Investigating LLMs as Voting Assistants via Contextual Augmentation: A Case Study on the European Parliament Elections 2024
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the accuracy of LLMs in predicting political party stances using a Voting Advice Application (VAA) dataset. While it touches upon societal issues and policy alignment, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as standalone components. Its discussion of ethics is confined to the standard 'Ethical Considerations' and 'Limitations' sections.
